## Three Institutions Add Corning Positions, Led by CORDA's $80 Million Entry

CORDA's $80M entry is a meaningfully sized institutional conviction buy in GLW; combined with two smaller simultaneous adds, it suggests broadening institutional interest in Corning — relevant context for the fiber/optical and display glass thesis, and worth tracking for follow-on accumulation.

- CORDA Investment Management initiated an $80.03M position in Corning — the largest and most substantive of three contemporaneous institutional buys.
- Clearstead Trust invested $2.45M and Focus Partners Advisor Solutions invested $4.78M in separate actions.
- All three are characterized as new or increased investments, not reductions.
- No investment rationale, catalyst, or thesis is disclosed in any of the headlines.
